initiative.title: Session editing: trim, combine, annotate
initiative.summary: Cut arbitrary ranges from a session, join sessions, and add a RegionShot-style annotation layer over the video, keeping marks, narration, transcript, activity and page events aligned with the edited video.

sources.anchor: trim/clip start, middle, end or anywhere; select regions to remove; combine traces; quick annotations layer on top of video; look at RegionShot; brainstorm + consider-contrast
tools: selection, rectangle, text, freehand, arrow, highlight, crop; single-key shortcuts; move/resize/delete; undo/redo

sources.location: README.md (Session output), Library/SessionModel.swift, Library/SessionData.swift, Library/Review.swift, Library/SessionTimeline.swift, scripts/process_session.py
sources.anchor: single recording.mp4; offsetSeconds on marks/activity/browser/transcript; review marks append to marks.jsonl then reprocess; AVPlayer on recording.mp4; timeline lanes without range selection

claims.statement: Remove any span of a session (start, middle, end, anywhere), any number of times, by selecting a range and removing it.
Add quick annotations in a layer on top of the video.
Annotation set stays simple; RegionShot's basic tools are enough.
Annotation interaction modeled on RegionShot: single-key tools, direct manipulation, undo/redo.
Cuts and joins must remap every time-based lane (marks, narration windows, transcript, activity, page events) so context stays true to the edited video.
Irreversible loss of the original capture through editing.
Non-destructive edit list beside recording.mp4, played via AVMutableComposition and rendered only on export.
Each session has one recording.mp4 (15 fps, <=1920 px, optional mic); all context is offsetSeconds from its start.
process_session.py derives session.json, frames, narration and Markdown from raw jsonl; review marks already use append-then-reprocess.
Playback is a single AVPlayer on recording.mp4.
SessionTimeline has lanes, playhead, hover and drag-to-seek but no range selection.
Edited result is for the user and exports (window, Markdown, Product Grid); annotations remain an in-app layer, burn-in not required.
Combine = join whole sessions end to end, then trim with normal cuts.
Original capture always kept; edits non-destructive and reversible.
Annotations default to a ~3 s span from the draw point, adjustable by dragging a timeline bar.

human_questions.question: Is the edited result mainly a shareable video file or a cleaner session for you and your exports?
human_questions.answer: Me and my exports: annotations stay an in-app layer; no burn-in required.

human_questions.question: Does combining traces mean whole sessions end to end, or picking ranges from several sessions?
human_questions.answer: Whole sessions end to end, then trim.

human_questions.question: May an edit ever change the original recording, or must the raw capture always be kept?
human_questions.answer: Always keep the original; edits non-destructive.

human_questions.question: Default annotation duration?
human_questions.answer: Fixed span (~3 s), shown as a draggable bar on the timeline.

options.name: Just the core
options.premise: Minimal: only the requested editing tools until use shows a need.

options.name: Cuts suggested from the context
options.premise: The recording's own context finds dead time; the user approves suggestions.

options.name: Edit by transcript
options.premise: Inversion: the transcript, not the timeline, is the editing surface.

options.name: Marks become chapters
options.premise: Marks are the outline; the output is a step-by-step narrative for a recipient.

options.name: Polish for viewers
options.premise: Automatic presentation polish; idle time is compressed rather than cut.

options.name: Redact before sharing
options.premise: Privacy before sharing: hide sensitive content before anything leaves the machine.

options.name: Many outputs from one edit
options.premise: One edit feeds many outputs: video, GIF, per-mark clips, captions, grid.

dimensions: marks and narration stay lined up

brainstorm.selected_option: hybrid: core + B2 context-suggested cuts + B4 mark-note captions (no reorder) + B6 blur rectangle; B7 dropped except exports respecting cuts (HQ-001)

shape.appetite: Focused editing layer for one person's own sessions: one segment model for cuts and joins, one annotation layer, existing export paths. Not a video editor.
shape.problem: Raw sessions contain dead time and span several recordings; marks and context must stay true to whatever video remains.
shape.recommended_shape: Edited session = ordered list of segments (source session, start, end) in edits.json beside untouched raw files. process_session.py is the single place that converts original times to edited times, producing session.json/Markdown/export in edited time; the Swift player builds an AVMutableComposition from the same segments. Raw jsonl and annotations.json stay in original time. Annotation layer is a SwiftUI overlay with RegionShot's tool set, normalized video coordinates, ~3 s default span.

success_moves.move: Unify cut and join as one segment-list model so joins add no new time-mapping logic.
Keep all raw data and annotations in original time; derive edited time only in process_session.py (and composition time in the player).
success_moves.reduces: irreversible drift when cuts are restored or reordered

success_moves.move: Prove the time conversion with a hand-written edits.json before building any range-selection interface.
success_moves.reduces: interface built on an unproven data model

success_moves.move: Reuse the existing append-then-reprocess path (Review.swift) for edits, so the window reloads via the existing session.json watch.
Deleting edits.json is the full rollback; nothing writes recording.mp4 or the raw jsonl files.
Keep Markdown/export video references in source recording plus original time.
success_moves.reduces: exports pointing at footage that doesn't exist at that time

first_proof.question: Can one segment list drive both edited-time context (via process_session.py) and edited-time playback (via AVMutableComposition), with frames, narration and new review marks all aligned?
first_proof.artifact: Hand-written edits.json with cuts at start, middle, end on a real session; reprocessed session opened in the Sessions window.
first_proof.observation: Playback skips ranges; mark frames match video at new times; narration quotes only kept speech; a review mark after the middle cut writes the correct original offset.
first_proof.decision_rule: All three hold → build range-selection interface and join on this model. Composition seeking or frame alignment fails → move frame extraction and time conversion into Swift before the interface.

rabbit_holes: AVMutableComposition seek precision and per-segment decode for 15 fps H.264
Joined sessions whose sources have different resolutions or no audio
Transcript sentence partially inside a cut
Review marks and annotations created in edited time must convert to source time
viewer.html cannot easily play a multi-source join
Draw-mode key conflicts (S = shot vs select)

dependencies.name: AVFoundation composition playback
dependencies.application_seam: Resolved segment table in session.json.segments; Swift EditMap builds AVMutableComposition and converts edited->source time.

first_proof_role.rationale: Local platform framework; the first proof needs real playback to judge seek precision.

proof_rungs: pure conversion unit tests + shared fixture
single-source three-cut composition in debug app (M1)
installed app on a fresh recording
dependencies.local_proof: tmp/ copies of real sessions in swift run ContextRecorder --library tmp/
dependencies.live_proof: No remote service; installed-app pass on a fresh recording confirms.
dependencies.rollout: Composition used only when edits.json is non-trivial; otherwise AVPlayer(url:) as today. Delete edits.json to revert.

fast_local_loop.command: python3 -m unittest scripts/test_process_session.py && python3 scripts/process_session.py tmp/<copy> && swift run ContextRecorder --library tmp/
fast_local_loop.failure_injection: fixture cases in scripts/fixtures/edit-cases.json; hand-edited edits.json; moved source folder for missing-source

milestones.title: A hand-written cut list plays and lines up
milestones.outcome: Copied session with edits.json plays without removed ranges; marks, frames, narration, lanes in edited time; review marks write original time.
milestones.proof: pure conversion unit tests + --self-test edits + debug-app inspection of three cuts and a post-cut review mark
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: No interface yet; sessions without edits.json unchanged.
milestones.rollback: Delete edits.json; code paths with one trivial segment match today's.

milestones.title: Cut ranges from the timeline
milestones.outcome: Select a range by ruler drag or I/O, Delete to cut, undo/redo/restore, Show Cuts, viewer.html skips cuts.
milestones.proof: Debug app: trim start/middle/end via UI, undo, restore one, Restore Original; Markdown and PGM export show edited times and source refs.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Cutting usable on single sessions; joins absent.
milestones.rollback: Restore Original deletes edits.json; feature can be hidden by removing the menu items.

milestones.title: Join sessions end to end
milestones.outcome: Join Sessions… creates a joined session referencing sources; plays through with one timeline; cut like any session.
milestones.proof: Join two or three tmp/ sessions incl. mixed size/audio; cut the joined session; move a source to see the banner.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Joined sessions coexist with normal ones; viewer.html shows a notice.
milestones.rollback: Delete the joined folder; sources untouched.

milestones.title: Annotation layer with rectangles and timing
milestones.outcome: Rectangles drawn in draw mode show for ~3 s, adjustable via a timeline lane bar, surviving cuts and resizes.
milestones.proof: Debug app: draw, play, drag span, cut across it, restore, resize window.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Annotation model proven with one tool.

milestones.title: The rest of RegionShot's tools
milestones.outcome: Arrow, text, highlight, freehand with RegionShot keys and direct manipulation.
milestones.proof: Debug app pass of each tool's create/move/resize/recolor/delete/undo; survives join and relaunch.

cut_line: cross-source ranges, reordering, speed ramps, auto-zoom, transcript editing

open_decisions.decision: Composition good enough for exact seeking and scrubbing across many segments?
open_decisions.evidence: drag across a dozen cuts; compare against frames/NNN.jpg
open_decisions.fallback: skip ranges on the source player for single-source cuts

open_decisions.decision: Full reprocess fast enough per cut?
open_decisions.evidence: time process_session.py on a 30-min, 20-mark session after a cut

open_decisions.decision: How to play mixed-size / silent sources in one composition?
open_decisions.evidence: join 1920-wide with smaller, silent with narrated
open_decisions.fallback: per-segment fit transform + empty audio; else refuse mixed-size joins
